name: Return of Zero — Episteme histories
description: Ten register histories as streams in time: stations mark each record’s own sections; bodies carry the record’s opening movement.

scenes.name: Ancient Philosophy — Measure, Tension, and the Form of Relation
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Ancient Philosophy — Measure, Tension, and the Form of Relation

text.body: The earliest Greek mathematical presence in the current source pool arrives indirectly through Kaplan's history of zero. Greek arithmetic and geometry achieved powerful forms without a positional zero, while Hellenistic astronomical tables used a circular sign to hold an absent degree, minute, or second. The sign had a local office inside measurement; it had not yet become the freely operating arithmetic zero developed in India.

scenes.name: Indian Philosophy — Differentiation, Emptiness, Manifestation, Recognition
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Indian Philosophy — Differentiation, Emptiness, Manifestation, Recognition

text.body: The *Sāṃkhya Kārikā* in the Colebrooke/Wilson carrier supplies an early functional discrimination among *buddhi*, *ahaṃkāra*, and *manas*: determination, appropriation under the form of I and mine, and coordination among presentations and alternatives. These belong to *prakṛti*'s articulated apparatus. *Puruṣa* occupies a different position as witness or experient.

text.title: Language, Law, Nation, and Centralisation — The Historical Tree of Topos, Logos, Nomos, Natio

text.body: The historical work carries two simultaneous offices already native to the essay's Jungian attitude to history.

scenes.name: Language, Symbol, and Dialogue — How Meaning Moves
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Language, Symbol, and Dialogue — How Meaning Moves

text.body: Dignāga's theory of *apoha* reaches the project through Pind's historical reconstruction and the debates collected in *Apoha: Buddhist Nominalism and Human Cognition*. A word does not need to grasp a universal essence shared by every object it names. It can determine its range by excluding what is other: “cow” functions through the exclusion of non-cow.

scenes.name: Mathematics — From the Empty Place to Recursive Return
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Mathematics — From the Empty Place to Recursive Return

text.body: Kaplan's historical spine separates three achievements often compressed into one invention. Babylonian scribes developed a separator for an absent internal place in sexagesimal notation. Hellenistic astronomers used a circular mark for an absent degree, minute, or second. Indian mathematicians brought zero into positional and arithmetic practice, where rules could state what it did under addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

scenes.name: Myth — Genealogy, Transformation, and Technē
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.body: Hesiod's *Theogony* provides the genealogy. The selected passages identify Cytherea with Aphrodite and place Harmonia among the children born to Aphrodite and Ares, alongside Panic and Fear. The poem gives a family relation, not a theory of reconciliation. That restraint makes the image stronger in §2 · #3: the essay's reading begins from a genuine genealogy and asks what it means that war and love can bear both terror and concord.

scenes.name: Process, Systems, and Science — From Substance to Participating Field
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Process, Systems, and Science — From Substance to Participating Field

text.body: Cusa's *On Learned Ignorance* develops coincidence, maximum and minimum, and geometrical figures whose limiting transformations approach an infinite relation without turning a finite construction into infinity itself. Flasch's study of Meister Eckhart situates Eckhart's distinctions between God and Godhead, intellect, creation, and the *in quantum* relation by which an identity holds according to a determinate respect.

scenes.name: Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Psychology — Crowd, Complex, Psychoid, and Provisional Self

text.body: Le Bon's *The Crowd* gives the source pool's earliest sustained account of a psychological crowd. His narrow structural point survives the racial and evolutionary doctrines that surround it: under shared influence, a collectivity can make its participants feel, think, and act differently from their isolated condition, and this formation can occur without physical assembly. The crowd is a combination that produces new characteristics.

scenes.name: Technology, Politics, and Institutions — From Mass Formation to Planetary Technē
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Technology, Politics, and Institutions — From Mass Formation to Planetary Technē

text.body: Le Bon's 1895 crowd psychology already allows a nation to become a psychological crowd under shared influences without physical assembly. Broadcast and network media later provide the channels for this distributed formation. Jung's *The Undiscovered Self* adds the relation between statistical abstraction, mass identity, collectivised responsibility, and a State that appears as a quasi-personality.

scenes.name: Zero, Subject, and the Advent of Integral Logic
scenes.character: A stream of the Logos in time; stations mark its movement.

text.title: Zero, Subject, and the Advent of Integral Logic

text.body: Kaplan supplies the narrative movement from Babylonian separator through astronomical absence-marker, Indian arithmetic, Arabic transmission, European reception, set-theoretic construction, and the boundary pair `0/1`, `1/0`. The source's force lies in the changing office of the sign.
